title: Description List
description: Key/value detail list composing the @moderno-ui/{framework} Divider, Badge, Button, Card, Skeleton and Alert primitives: one term and value per row, a status value as a Badge and an optional row action, with its own empty, loading and error renders; responds to its container (@container) — stacked below @md, the row action moves beside its value at @sm, the term sits beside its value at @md and the term column narrows at @lg.
